title: Add delivered-to-device intermediate receipt state
description: Current spec has deliveredAt (stored by mailbox) and readAt (read by human) but no intermediate delivered-to-device state. This conflates app-foreground/notification-received with human reading. Requires a new field (e.g. deviceDeliveredAt) in deliveryReceipts on Message and in Peer/receipt arguments. Low priority since it requires OS cooperation and is the weakest of the three states. Affects draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (Message type) and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md (Peer/receipt).
close_reason: Added deviceDeliveredAt to Message.deliveryReceipts (chat-00.md:519) and Peer/receipt Request Arguments (federation-00.md:295)
